about_the_game:
Nemesis - Home Front is the third Nemesis expansion to release for WARNO. This DLC features two brand-new divisions: the Warsaw Pact Soviet defenders of the 157-yaMotostrelkovaya Diviziya and the mixed troops of NATO’s US 6th Infantry Division (Light).

WARNO’s World War III engulfs the front lines in West Germany and beyond. However, the rear areas of both NATO and the Warsaw Pact are vulnerable to a wide array of potential flanking operations, raids, and amphibious or airborne assaults. Both sides equip and raise various units to defend their shores and critical sectors. Nemesis - Home Front presents two well-equipped defensive divisions with additional naval support, to bolster their arsenal and manpower.

Nemesis - Home Front features two brand-new WARNO Divisions with a host of new units, weapons, vehicles, and more. Customize your Nemesis battlegroup and take them to war in WARNO’s single-player Skirmish, Ranked, and online Multiplayer.

US 6th Infantry Division (Light)

NATO’s US 6th Infantry Division (Light)’s main task was the defense of Alaska from a direct Soviet invasion across the Bering Sea. The formation could even count on some limited power projection to take the war to any communist takeover of the Aleutian Islands. Limited in armored vehicles, the division combines, under unified command, light infantry, paratroopers, navy, air force, and National Guard units.

The core of the US 6th Infantry Division (Light) is made up of LIGHT RIFLES and AIRBORNE RIFLES. Other equipment includes CH-54B TARHE heavy-lift helicopters, M119 105mm howitzers and AH-1S 'Nam-era Cobras. The National Guard is represented by ALASKAN SCOUTS, N.G. M48A5 ACAV recon tank, and A-7D CORSAIR II attack aircraft. The US Air Force not only provides the new OA-10A recon Thunderbolt but also USAF SECURITY squads with PEACEKEEPER wheeled APCs. The US Navy brings the A-6E INTRUDER and EA-6B PROWLER, plus USMC SECURITY guarding naval bases with DRAGON 300 APCs, and the renowned NAVY SEALS special forces from nearby local training centers.

Soviet 157-ya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya

Warsaw Pact’s Soviet 157-ya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya was a mobilization division with a small cadre of professional soldiers based in Crimea. In case of any enemy invasion, the formation would have absorbed nearby training units and Black Sea Fleet coastal defense assets.

The formation counts on the ubiquitous MOTOSTRELKI riding to battle in a limited number of BMP-1s and BTR-60s. REZERVISTI fills out the rest of the ranks relying on older BTR-152K and BTR-40. The leftovers are grouped in truck-borne PARTIZANI squads with equally obsolete small arms. Tanks are older models, from T-54B and T-55As, with even some ancient IS-2M filling out the ranks. Local arms depots would provide a smattering of old weaponry, such as BS-3 100mm anti-tank guns, D-1 152mm howitzer, BM-24M MLRS and World War 2 antiques such as B-4M 203mm and Br-5M 280mm super-heavy artillery.
Navy and coastal defense units include KSM-65 100mm in an anti-tank role, K-1 recon helicopter, and still-being-tested A222 BEREG 130mm self-propelled gun. Air support includes the new Su-15TM and T-10K (a navalized Su-27K).

Main Features


  • Command two new WARNO Divisions in Skirmish, Ranked or online Multiplayer: the US US 6th Infantry Division (Light) and the Soviet 157-ya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya.
  • Take charge of new units, including US ALASKAN SCOUTS, the renowned NAVY SEALS special forces, Soviet PARTIZANI, and a host of new vehicles, such as CH-54B TARHE helicopters, DRAGON 300 APCs, A-6E INTRUDER, and IS-2M tanks, B-4M 203mm and Br-5M 280mm super-heavy artillery, A222 BEREG, K-1 recon helicopter, and Su-15TM and T-10K aircraft.

short_description: Defend with all your might with two new navy-bolstered divisions of Nemesis - Home Front featuring new units, vehicles, and weapons. The Alaskan-based US US 6th Infantry Division (Light) faces off against the Soviet Crimean-located 157-ya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya.
